description: <p>Marketing teams are stuck between fragmented customer data and martech stacks that copy that data into proprietary silos while customers expect real-time, personalized experiences. Customer Lake, the agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP) built natively into Databricks, changes that equation. It unifies first- and third-party data into governed Customer 360 profiles, resolves identities, and uses agents to build audiences, recommend next-best actions, and activate campaigns across channels, all without copying data out of the Lakehouse or adding vendor lock-in.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The Solutions Architect (Customer Lake) team is part of a dedicated, global go-to-market organization focused on driving adoption and revenue growth for Customer Lake, Databricks’ agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP) built natively into the Data Intelligence Platform. The Customer Lake SA will engage clients across business units and verticals, build relationships with marketing and data stakeholders, position Customer Lake in depth, and deliver presentations, demos, and POCs that drive informed adoption decisions. They will understand the guardrails and the steps needed to successfully land and expand Customer Lake as clients deliver on their customer engagement and growth objectives.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on customer data and marketing projects, ranging from architectural design to data engineering to identity resolution, audience activation, and agent deployment</li> <li>Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory, driving Customer Lake adoption from initial Customer 360 build-out through full CDP augmentation or replacement.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect building technical credibility with CMOs, heads of marketing technology (MarTech), data engineering leaders, and marketing and analytics teams to drive product adoption and vision.</li> <li>Enable clients at scale through workshops, POC execution, and developing customer-facing collateral that increases technical knowledge and demonstrates the value of an embedded, agentic CDP architecture.</li> <li>Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams.</li> <li>Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical, customer-facing data environments.</li> <li>Establish and refine the sales qualification and POC intake process, ensuring well-scoped engagements that maximize customer success and minimize friction for R&amp;D.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Competencies &amp; Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of customer data platform (CDP), marketing technology (MarTech), or customer data engineering expertise, with a proven track record of designing and delivering client-facing customer data and activation solutions (of which 3+ years are in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role).</li> <li>Experience with design and implementation of data and AI applications for marketing and customer engagement, including identity resolution, segmentation, personalization and next-best-action, and agentic AI workflows for audience building and campaign activation.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with CDP and martech/adtech platforms, including composable-CDP architectures (Salesforce Data Cloud, Adobe, Segment, Treasure Data, Braze, or similar), including implementation, identity resolution, audience activation, and migration strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of the customer data landscape: first-party data marketing and customer data initiatives.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with an understanding of cloud-native data description: Everyone at idealo bases decisions on data. Our vision is to transform idealo from a transactional price comparison platform into a personalised shopping companion that inspires users throughout their entire product discovery journey. To make this vision a reality, we are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (m|f|x) who is passionate about building scalable, cloud-native machine learning systems. Working in a cross-functional team alongside Product Managers, UX Designers, Software Engineers and Data Scientists, you will help create personalised experiences that make shopping more relevant, engaging and inspiring for millions of users. About your new role You will help shape one of idealo's most strategic product initiatives: Personalisation. You will work closely with our Data Scientists throughout the entire machine learning lifecycle. While they focus on developing and validating machine learning models, your focus will be designing the cloud infrastructure, ML pipelines and operational tooling that enable these models to run reliably, scale efficiently and continuously improve in production. In this role, you will: Build and operate scalable machine learning infrastructure on AWS. Design, develop and deploy production-ready ML pipelines covering training, inference, monitoring and automated retraining. Bring machine learning models into production for personalized recommendations, discovery feeds, search ranking and related use cases. Build cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and modern CI/CD practices. Ensure the high availability, observability and operational excellence of ML systems. Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Managers and UX Designers to continuously improve personalized customer experiences. Skills & Requirements At least three years of professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Software Engineer or Cloud Engineer, including exposure to production ML systems. Experience with ML platforms such as AWS SageMaker or comparable technologies, including deploying, operating and monitoring models in production. Solid knowledge of machine learning concepts and model evaluation; experience with recommendation systems, search, ranking, vector search or embeddings is a strong plus. Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams, with excellent written and spoken English; German is a plus. As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back. Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. High attention to detail and comfort with repetitive, high-volume administrative work. Strong communication skills and confidence working with multiple stakeholders. Fluent English (spoken and written). Nice-to-haves  Basic understanding of product data, master data, or ERP/PIM systems. Experience with data cleansing or migration projects. title: Senior Design Engineer, Design System
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>Why this role matters</strong></p> <p>At Celonis, design has to scale across a complex, enterprise-grade process intelligence platform, and increasingly, it has to scale to machines as well as people. AI coding agents now generate a growing share of the UI our engineers ship, and our design system is the contract that keeps that output on-brand, accessible, and consistent.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of design, engineering, and product, with a strong emphasis on craft, usability, and scalability. You'll design and build the system itself, owning interaction decisions and front-end architecture, and translating complex process data and AI-driven behaviors into intuitive, high-performance experiences. It's a senior role: you'll often operate with minimal design oversight, set standards, lead initiatives, and mentor others while staying deeply hands-on in both design and code.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>You'll join the team that owns Celonis's design system and the operations behind how design gets done. We sit at the intersection of design and engineering, and we treat the system as a living product with real users, internal designers, product engineers, and the AI agents that now consume it.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build production components in Angular and TypeScript, our design system is built in Angular and we may adopt React over time, on a foundation of rock-solid HTML and CSS (semantic markup, ARIA, and modern CSS custom properties driving design tokens).</li> <li>Own interaction decisions, component design, and front-end architecture end-to-end, independently translating ambiguous requirements into thoughtful, usable UX.</li> <li>Translate complex process-intelligence data and AI-driven behaviors into clear, intuitive, high-performance operator experiences.</li> <li>Set the technical and craft standard for front-end quality, polish, motion and animation, performance, and accessibility, across the team.</li> <li>Drive rapid prototyping to explore novel interaction concepts and turn ambitious design visions into distinctive, testable experiences.</li> <li>Collaborate with designers, PMs, and engineers to derive and evolve the design system through a healthy contribution model.</li> <li>Make the system agent-ready: maintain tokens-as-code in the W3C DTCG format (Style Dictionary or similar) and structure component metadata, docs, and APIs so AI coding agents can consume them as reliable context.</li> <li>Author and maintain Figma Code Connect mappings so Figma components link cleanly to their coded counterparts for engineers and agents alike.</li> <li>Build evals as guardrails, visual-regression, accessibility, and token-compliance checks in CI, so generated and contributed UI meets the bar before it ships.</li> <li>Use AI tooling daily (Figma Make, v0, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar), applying senior design and engineering judgment to critique and correct the output.</li> <li>Lead system initiatives and mentor designers and engineers contributing to it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Around 5–8 years across design engineering / UX engineering / front-end, including significant hands-on work building a design system or component library in a SaaS or B2B environment.</li> <li>Excellent UX instincts with strong attention to interaction detail and usability, you can own design decisions independently, with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Strong production front-end skills in Angular and TypeScript with rock-solid HTML and CSS fundamentals; experience with (or genuine openness to) React is a plus.</li> <li>Deep understanding of design token architecture (primitive → semantic → component tiers) and modern token pipelines.</li> <li>Strong Figma fluency and comfort moving fluidly between design and code.</li> <li>Demonstrated accessibility expertise (WCAG 2.2) implemented in code.</li> <li>Hands-on fluency week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help to ensure the operation of Planet’s internal IT systems, specifically architecting and maintaining our identity providers (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).</li> <li>Improve existing and create new solutions by engineering automated zero-day Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows directly from our HRIS (e.g., HiBob).</li> identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM).</li> <li>Practical understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycles (S/MIME, X.509), and managing legacy directories like Active Directory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operational experience in deploying and maintaining databases.</li> <li>Experience using Docker, ECS or Linux Containers in a production description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p><strong>This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants based in Spain, Ireland, Germany, the UK or Sweden at this time.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Loki Query&nbsp; | EMEA | Remote</strong></h3> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack</p> <p>The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are<a href="https://github.com/grafana/mimir"> Mimir for metrics</a>,<a href="https://github.com/grafana/loki"> Loki for logs</a>,<a href="https://github.com/grafana/tempo"> Tempo for traces</a>, and<a href="https://github.com/grafana/pyroscope"> Pyroscope for profiles</a>. Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and running on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (GCP, Azure, AWS). We also have engineers working on<a href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus"> Prometheus</a>,<a href="https://github.com/grafana/agent"> Grafana Agent</a>,<a href="https://grafana.com/blog/2022/07/25/new-in-grafana-mimir-ingest-graphite-datadog-influx-and-prometheus-metrics-into-a-single-storage-backend/"> Mimir proxies</a>, and OpenTelemetry.</p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our tech stack is mostly made up of services written in Go, running on multiple Kubernetes clusters that leverage Cloud object storage.</p> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. description: About the role Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team. Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape. Who you are You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English Your potential growth path: Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs Your performance objectives 📣 Generate pipeline Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually. Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery. Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles. 💪 Close opportunities Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning. Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains). Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success. 💡 Build expertise Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams. Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions. 📈 Lead by example Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets. Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook. Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact. 🇪🇺 Your territory You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential. 📍 Work location Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered). Whom you'll be working with Clifton Lobo , VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression Sebastian Schaal , Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing Inga Schwarz , Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap 💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here . ⚡️ About Luminovo Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry . We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress. We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain. To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million . Our core principles: putting people first & building great things As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍 Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things. We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at. You will work in a feature team developing the Phone Assistant, Doctolib's solution that combines LLM reasoning, speech recognition, and real-time backend systems, launching first in Germany and expanding to France and Italy.&nbsp;</p> <p>Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.</p> still encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>You'll be a great fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have 5+ years of backend engineering experience building scalable, resilient systems in <strong>Node.js/TypeScript</strong> (with some Python)</li> <li>Have hands-on production experience building LLM-based features: prompting, tool calling, structured outputs, eval frameworks, and ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision<a href="https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/"> here</a>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the</em><a href="https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/"><em> </em><em>Doctolib Tech site</em></a><em>.</em></p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib</li> <li>28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)</li> <li>Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy</li> <li>Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz</li> <li>Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)</li> <li>The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more</li> <li>Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth</li> <li>Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care</li> <li>Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club</li> <li>A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode</li> <li>Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit</li> <li>For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support</li> <li>Relocation support in case of international mobility</li> <li>Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our interview process</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Recruiter Interview</li> <li>Live Coding Interview</li> <li>System Design Interview</li> <li>Behavioral Interview</li> <li>At least one reference check</li> </ul> <p>We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. title: Weather Analytics Internship Program
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Us</strong></h2> <p>Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.&nbsp; Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.</p> <p>In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.</p> <p>Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: <strong>Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship</strong>.</p></div><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Weather Analytics Internship Program<br></strong>Six-Month Internship: 15 February – 12 August 2027<br>Berlin (full-time, on site)<br>Closing Date: 20 September 2026</p> <p>Engelhart’s Internship Program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in weather analytics within a global commodities business. The intern will work closely with the global Weather Analytics team in Berlin on data-led and technical projects that support the use, interpretation and visualisation of weather data across the business. To be eligible for consideration, <strong>applicants must be available to commence their six-month internship from 15 February 2027</strong>.</p> <p>We are also hiring for Power Analytics, Renewables Analytics and Renewables Origination Analytics internships in Berlin and Grenoble. These have separate application processes due to their different candidate profiles. Further details are available on our Careers Page.</p> <p><strong>What You Can Expect</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience within a specialist weather analytics team based in Berlin and beyond, working on technical projects with practical relevance to energy and commodities markets.</li> <li>Exposure to weather data, forecasting products, APIs and visualisation tools used by commercial and analytical teams.</li> <li>Opportunities to work with Python, weather data formats, and tools used in the broader weather ecosystem, including NWP and AI model outputs.</li> <li>Close learning and mentorship from experienced weather, analytics and technology professionals in a global commodities business.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with the Weather Analytics team on technical, analytical and data visualisation projects.</li> <li>Support the development, testing or improvement of APIs and tools used to access and distribute weather data and products.</li> <li>Analyse and process weather datasets using Python and other relevant tools.</li> <li>Support the visualisation of weather products in AD and other internal platforms.</li> <li>Work with weather data formats and ecosystem tools, potentially including ECMWF ecCodes.</li> <li>Build understanding of numerical weather prediction, AI weather models and the wider weather data ecosystem.</li> <li>Present findings, outputs or technical progress clearly to weather, analytics and commercial stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a motivated, intellectually curious individual who is keen to apply technical and analytical skills to weather-related challenges in energy and commodities markets. You should be comfortable working with data, learning new tools quickly, and collaborating with weather, trading and technology stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.</p> <p>The following experiences and skills are essential for application:</p> <ul> <li>Strong academic background in Computer Science, Atmospheric Sciences, Meteorology, or a closely related technical or quantitative discipline.</li> <li>Strong Python skills, with the ability to analyse, manipulate and interpret complex datasets.</li> <li>Evidence of applying data analysis, coding or quantitative methods to a practical problem, gained through academic projects, internships, research, personal projects or other relevant experience.</li> <li>Demonstrable interest in weather, forecasting, climate, energy markets or commodities, including an ability to discuss relevant developments gained through academic study, projects, research, or personal interest.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach.</li> <li>Effective communication skills and a collaborative mindset.</li> <li>Business-level English proficiency.</li> </ul> <p>The following would be advantageous:</p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with weather ecosystem tools, such as ECMWF ecCodes.</li> <li>Knowledge of numerical weather prediction, AI weather models, weather data formats or meteorological datasets.</li> <li>Experience with APIs, data visualisation, dashboards or internal tooling.</li> <li>Exposure to energy markets, power markets, renewables or commodities would be helpful but is not required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Key Account Manager
description: Was erwartet dich in dieser Position? Als Key Account Manager (m/w/d) betreust und entwickelst du die wichtigsten Apothekenpartnerschaften von Montu in ganz Deutschland. Du verantwortest ein strategisch relevantes Vertriebsgebiet, baust Beziehungen zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträger:innen weiter aus und steigerst die kommerzielle Performance durch strategische Beratung und eine konsequente Betreuung deiner Accounts. Die Position ist dynamisch, eigenverantwortlich und ideal für jemanden, der Freude daran hat, Geschäftsbereiche aktiv aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln, anstatt bestehende Strukturen lediglich zu verwalten. Was sind deine Aufgaben? Sales Growth Identifikation und Umsetzung von Upselling-, Cross-Selling- und Wachstumspotenzialen. Gewinnung neuer Accounts mit hohem Potenzial und Ausbau der Marktpräsenz von Montu. Unterstützung von Apotheken bei der Optimierung ihrer operativen Prozesse im Bereich medizinisches Cannabis. Account Management Betreuung und strategische Weiterentwicklung eines Portfolios bedeutender Apotheken und Kliniken. Aufbau langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu wichtigen Stakeholdern und Entscheidungsträger:innen. Führung fundierter Gespräche über Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, Wachstumspotenziale und das Produktportfolio. Markt- & Geschäftsanalyse Kontinuierliche Beobachtung von Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Marktentwicklungen. Weitergabe relevanter Marktkenntnisse und Kundenfeedbacks an das Sales Leadership Team zur Weiterentwicklung der kommerziellen Strategie. Sorgfältige Pflege des CRM-Systems sowie zuverlässiges Reporting relevanter KPIs. Bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus Inside Sales, Customer Service, Logistics und Compliance. Partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Medical- und Marketing-Teams bei Informations-, Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen. Teilnahme an relevanten Branchenveranstaltungen sowie professionelle Repräsentation von Montu. Außendienst Durchführung gezielter persönlicher Kundenbesuche mit Fokus auf qualitativ hochwertige und wirkungsorientierte Termine anstelle einer reinen Maximierung der Besuchsanzahl. Was bringst du mit? Berufserfahrung im Bereich Sales, Key Account Management oder Business Development. Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, in der Pharmaindustrie, Medizintechnik oder einer anderen regulierten Branche ist von Vorteil. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten. Fähigkeit, medizinische und therapeutische Informationen zu verstehen und verständlich zu vermitteln. Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Erfahrung im Management einer vielfältigen Sales-Pipeline. Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Gültiger Führerschein. Warum Montu? Gestalte mit uns durch innovative Telemedizinlösungen die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung in Deutschland. Werde Teil eines internationalen Teams mit einer kollaborativen und flexiblen Arbeitskultur. Arbeite in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen, in dem deine Arbeit direkten und sichtbaren Einfluss hat. Profitiere von Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität und vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit mindestens einem Tag pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro. Über Montu Bei Montu sind wir davon überzeugt, dass der Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung einfach, schnell und auf den Menschen ausgerichtet sein sollte – nicht auf Systeme. Deshalb gestalten wir die Patient Journey neu: mit einer nahtlosen, digital ausgerichteten Erfahrung, die medizinische Versorgung leichter zugänglich macht. Unsere innovative Telemedizinplattform, unsere internationale Präsenz und unser umfassendes Portfolio an cannabisbasierten Arzneimitteln unterstützen Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheker:innen dabei, traditionelle Barrieren zu überwinden und Menschen zu befähigen, ihre Gesundheit selbstbestimmt in die Hand zu nehmen. raw.title: Sr. Account Executive - Enterprise
raw.description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

your mission:

You will be pivotal to telli’s growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing complex, high-value deals (€100k+ land deal size). As one of the first Sr. Enterprise AEs at telli, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we win, navigate, and scale our enterprise sales motion.

what you'll do:

  • Own complex enterprise deals end-to-end: Lead €100k+ deals from first discovery through signature, including demos, business cases, security reviews, procurement, legal, contract negotiations, and executive alignment. You uncover where telli creates measurable value and build the case to make it a priority.

  • Build and own your pipeline: Our SDR team supports you, but you can generate own Enterprise pipeline. You identify the right accounts, develop account strategies, write outbound, make the calls, and create opportunities where none existed before.

  • Navigate complex buying committees: Build relationships across Sales, Operations, CX, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and the C-Suite at large organizations. You identify champions, understand internal politics, and create consensus across multiple stakeholders.

  • Run strategic, multi-threaded sales processes: You don't rely on a single champion. You map the organization, understand who influences the decision, and build relationships at multiple levels long before procurement enters the process.

  • Own a quota and close €100k+ deals: Drive meaningful new ARR and take full accountability for your forecast, pipeline coverage, and revenue target.

  • Build compelling business cases: Translate telli's product into measurable commercial impact for the customer and make the ROI clear enough to win internal budget and executive sponsorship.

  • Bring the customer into the company: Feed structured insights back into product, marketing, and strategy. You sit closest to some of our most important prospects and customers, and your signal helps shape what we build next.

title: Account Executive (all genders)
description: Wemolo entwickelt die digitale Infrastruktur für die nächste Generation von Parkraum und Immobilien. Mit mehr als 4.000 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv – und wachsen weiter. Als Account Executive (all genders) bist du ein zentraler Treiber unseres Wachstums. Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, baust Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf und verantwortest deine Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kunden und bestehende Partnerschaften gleichermaßen weiter. Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielen und Deals nicht nur begleiten, sondern selbst gewinnen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Die Position ist hybrid mit drei festen Office-Tagen pro Woche an unserem Standort in München-Thalkirchen. What to expect Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch eine hochwertige Pipeline auf. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kontakte zu konkreten Opportunities. Understand & qualify: Du führst Discovery-Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden. So erkennst du, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann, und entwickelst relevante Business Cases. Own the sales cycle (360° Sales): Du verantwortest deine Deals vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Closing. Du hältst überzeugende Präsentationen, koordinierst relevante Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass Opportunities konsequent vorankommen. Negotiate & close: Du führst Verhandlungen auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen, gehst souverän mit Einwänden um und bringst Deals erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Grow your accounts: Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und identifizierst weiteres Potenzial in bestehenden Accounts. Dein Ziel sind nicht nur gewonnene Deals, sondern nachhaltige Partnerschaften. Own your performance: Du kennst deine Pipeline und KPIs, analysierst deine Ergebnisse und entwickelst deinen Sales Approach kontinuierlich weiter. Inspire us by Sales Experience: Du bringst mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Sales mit und hast bereits eigenständig Kunden gewonnen und Deals abgeschlossen. Erfahrung mit Small und Medium Accounts ist ein Plus. Ambition & Drive : Du setzt dir hohe Ziele, willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen und bleibst auch dann dran, wenn es herausfordernd wird. Communication : Du trittst selbstbewusst auf, kannst Menschen für dich gewinnen und kommunizierst souverän mit Entscheidern auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen. Commercial Mindset: Du verstehst Geschäftsmodelle und Kundenbedürfnisse und kannst daraus relevante Sales Opportunities entwickeln. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert und datenbasiert. Growth Mindset : Du willst kontinuierlich besser werden, suchst aktiv Feedback und setzt Learnings direkt in bessere Ergebnisse um. Languages : Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und sprichst fließend Englisch. Mobility : Du hast einen gültigen Führerschein der Klasse B und bist bereit, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen (ca. 10–20 %). What we offer Earn & grow: Attraktives OTE-Modell aus Fixgehalt und ungedeckeltem Bonus – starke Performance soll sich für dich lohnen. Learn fast : Strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching, Shadowing und direktes Feedback helfen dir, deine Sales Skills schnell weiterzuentwickeln. Own your numbers : Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und KPIs und hast gleichzeitig den Freiraum, deinen eigenen Sales Style zu entwickeln. Work smarter with AI : KI ist Teil deines täglichen Workflows – für effizienteren Research, bessere Insights und schnellere Vorbereitung. Flexibility & Mobility : Drei feste Office-Tage in München-Thalkirchen, flexibles Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie Bike-Leasing oder Fahrtkostenzuschuss. Team & Culture : Eine ambitionierte Teamkultur, kurze Wege und gemeinsame Erfolge bei Teamevents und OKR-Partys. Health & Balance : EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen. Best-in-class setup : Mac oder Windows, ergonomisches Equipment und alles, was du für effizientes Arbeiten im Office und Homeoffice brauchst. Come as you are : Kein Dresscode – uns interessiert, was du bewegst, nicht was du trägst. Innovation through diversity Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt. Still here? Dann könnten wir ein perfektes Match sein! Bewirb dich am besten über unser Bewerbungsportal - so landet deine Bewerbung direkt bei uns im Team und wir können sie schnell und unkompliziert prüfen. At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: One source of truth for a company that runs on data

As Senior Analytics Engineer, you own voize's company data from the warehouse to the dashboards. You'll be part of our Data & AI function - ensuring the data voize and our AI layer runs on are reliable, safe & scalable. The modern stack (Redshift, dbt, Fivetran, Lightdash) is already live: you make it rock-solid and turn it into the single source of truth the whole company runs on, from ARR to product adoption. As our first dedicated analytics hire, you partner directly with Finance, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success, turning their questions into numbers everyone trusts.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Model company data in dbt on Redshift: layered, tested, documented models built to outlive you

  • Ship and run the company KPI dashboard in Lightdash, plus self-serve analytics for every team

  • Own metric modeling and propose the definitions the whole company runs on. Sign-off sits with data leadership, and you make every number defensible

  • Keep the ingestion layer running day to day (Fivetran connectors, existing ETL jobs), in close coordination with engineering

  • Act as a partner to our teams and turn ambiguous business questions from Finance, RevOps, Product, and CS into trusted, self-serve answers

  • Shape the data foundation before the function scales. As a Head of (Internal) Data & AI and a further Engineers join, you set the standards they inherit and go deeper on the architecture the whole company trusts.

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 4+ years owning analytics from the warehouse onwards (modelling, reporting, BI) in production, ideally as an early or founding data hire

  • Deep SQL above all, plus strong dbt (layered models, tests, CI, semantic / metric layers)

  • A cloud data warehouse in production (Redshift ideal; Snowflake or BigQuery with willingness to switch) and a BI tool people actually use

  • Business-facing autonomy: you partner with non-technical stakeholders, propose and defend metric definitions, and ship without waiting for a data team to form around you

  • You document, test, and monitor by default, and finishing the 10% that makes a model trustworthy

  • You know how to leverage AI, you have a track record of automating & building workflows with AI.

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

title: Director of Product Design
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers. Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars. We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses. That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve. WHAT YOU'LL DO Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years. Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger. Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience. Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it. Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers. title: Senior Manager, FP&A
description: <h3><strong>About Behavox</strong></h3> <p>Behavox is a cloud-native AI company providing an integrated controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, insurance businesses, and commodity firms. The platform unifies communications and trade surveillance, compliant archiving, policy management as well as front-office analytics on a single, AI-native technology stack, delivered as a globally scalable SaaS-based cloud service.</p> <p>At Behavox, our engineering culture is built around speed, experimentation, and technical excellence, following agile principles and rapid iteration. We constantly test and adopt the latest cloud technologies and AI tooling, optimising for fast feedback loops and execution. We look for people who can move fast, challenge conventional wisdom, and who want to work at the frontier of modern AI, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems.</p> <p>Behavox is a high-performance organisation with a strong bias toward delivery, ownership, and responsibility. We commit, and we execute. We are building systems that are complex, mission-critical, and global in scale; systems that many consider too large or too difficult. To do that, we seek the smartest, most technically capable engineers and technologists who take end-to-end responsibility and want to win by building what others cannot.</p> <p>Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.</p> <p>Work type: Hybrid&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Manager, FP&amp;A reports to the Chief Operating Officer and owns the financial planning and analysis function for a global business generating over $50M in revenue, with a growth trajectory toward $200M over the next 3 years. The role establishes the planning calendar, forecasting methodology, and management reporting cadence, and runs them with limited direction across a multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction environment. It is accountable for the annual budget, the re-forecast, and the management reporting that the CEO and COO plan against.</p> <p>The role is the primary analytical partner to functional leaders and works in close partnership with strategic finance. It translates operating plans, pipeline, and headcount plans from Sales, RevOps, and People into controlled financial outputs, and explains performance against plan in terms leaders can act on. It owns the integrity of the company's planning models, and that ownership sets the boundary with strategic finance: deal origination, valuation, and financing analysis sit outside core FP&amp;A, but every completed acquisition has to be absorbed into the operating plan, forecast, and reporting baseline this role owns. The two functions therefore work together from diligence onward rather than at handover, so that the assumptions underwriting a deal survive into the model the company plans against.</p> <p>The Senior Manager, FP&amp;A leads the FP&amp;A team and is accountable for its output quality, its operating model, and its capacity to scale with the business. The role is expected to make FP&amp;A AI-native: each planning and reporting cycle must become faster, more accurate, and better controlled through automation and AI-enabled workflows, within the systems and control framework that governs the wider finance function.</p> <h3><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What You'll Bring</span></strong></h3> <ol> <li><strong>Forecasting and financial model architecture</strong> — Knowledge of driver-based forecasting, budgeting, scenario planning, investment analysis, and the design principles that keep a model auditable, maintainable, and able to absorb a new entity without being rebuilt. Applies this knowledge to build models that scale with the business through both organic growth and acquisition.</li> <li><strong>Revenue, pipeline, and commission economics</strong> — Knowledge of bookings, recurring revenue, renewals, pipeline conversion, revenue recognition timing as it affects the forecast, and commission plan mechanics. Applies this knowledge to convert pipeline and contract data into a revenue forecast and commission forecast that hold up to scrutiny.</li> <li><strong>Headcount, cost, and cash planning</strong> — Knowledge of personnel planning and costing, non-personnel opex, capex, cost allocation, and the FX exposure and entity-level cost flows that shape a multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction forecast. Applies this knowledge to build personnel and non-personnel budgets and a cash-flow forecast that reconcile to actuals.</li> <li><strong>Management and board reporting</strong> — Knowledge of KPI design, variance analysis, management reporting structure, and the conventions of board and investor packs. Applies this knowledge to produce reporting that leadership plans against, with the analysis behind each number ready when challenged.</li> <li><strong>FP&amp;A systems, data, and automation</strong> — Knowledge of planning tools, data flows from finance, CRM, and HR systems, workflow automation, and AI-enabled analysis. Applies this knowledge to identify where manual effort and error enter the planning and reporting cycle and to select the tooling that removes them</li> </ol> <h3><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What You'll Do</span></strong></h3> <ol> <li><strong>FP&amp;A team leadership and operating model</strong> — Leads the FP&amp;A team by owning model responsibilities, the planning calendar, review controls, documentation, data flows, hiring, coaching, and role design, so that the function scales while maintaining consistent output quality without dependency on any single analyst.</li> <li><strong>Budgeting and re-forecasting</strong> — Owns the annual budget and re-forecast cadence end to end by establishing assumptions with functional leaders and translating Sales, RevOps, and People inputs into controlled pipeline-to-revenue bridges, personnel and non-personnel budgets, commission forecasts, opex, and capex, so that each planning cycle delivers a controlled financial baseline on the agreed calendar.</li> <li><strong>Financial modelling, scenario analysis, and acquisition integration</strong> — Builds, maintains, and reviews the operating plan, forecast, cash-flow, scenario, and acquisition-integration models by testing model logic and sensitivities, reconciling deal assumptions to post-close actuals, and establishing the combined baseline for completed acquisitions, so that the company plans against maintainable models that preserve deal assumptions and show performance against the acquisition case.</li> <li><strong>Management, board, and investor reporting</strong> — Drives the management reporting cycle and financial analysis for board and investor packs by translating variance to plan into operational drivers and stating the resulting implications for the forecast, so that leadership can use the reporting directly to make planning decisions.</li> <li><strong>Planning process automation</strong> — Drives automation and AI-enabled workflows by redesigning data collection, plan consolidation, variance analysis, and report production and measuring changes in cycle time, error rate, and analyst hours, so that planning and reporting become faster and better controlled while analyst capacity shifts from data handling to analysis.</li> </ol> <h3><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What We Offer </span></strong></h3> <ul> <li>The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies.</li> <li>A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence.</li> <li>A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, and an equity award aligned with long-term value creation.</li> <li>Modern, comfortable offices in Toronto and Montreal. This is a hybrid role (1 day in office).&nbsp;</li> <li>A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span data-sheets-root="1"><strong>About Our Process</strong><br></span></span></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span data-sheets-root="1">We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.</span></span></p> <h3><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">Please note that:</span></strong></h3> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of&nbsp;AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited&nbsp;and will result in immediate&nbsp;disqualification&nbsp;from the process&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Interviews may be recorded&nbsp;for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Legora has grown from 40 to more than 900 people in 18 months. During that time, we reached $100M ARR, tripled our valuation in five months, and continued expanding into new markets around the world.

description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($60M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Sales Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results. Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role. What You'll Own Sales strategy and structure Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve Data and performance management Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it Process, structure, and scalability Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount Team leadership and org design Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well Global and remote team leadership Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here Exec partnership and GTM planning Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic Who Will Thrive in This Role Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others doing the same. This isn't a role for a single-lane specialist. Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter. Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability. People leader and org designer. You've led sales managers or leaders — not just individual contributors — and operated at least one layer removed from the front line. You have a track record of hiring and developing leaders beneath you, and making clear calls about what to centralise versus what to delegate. Exec partner. You've partnered directly with a CEO, founder, or C-suite on revenue planning and commercial trade-offs. You can push back on unrealistic targets while maintaining trust, and you can translate company strategy into an actionable, sequenced sales roadmap. Builder, not just operator. You've introduced new process, data infrastructure, or org structure in a previous role — not only operated within a system someone else built. This role is not about being a super-IC closer or a sector-pedigree hire; logistics experience is welcome but not a requirement or a filter. Compensation, Benefits & Workplace Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success. Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it. 25 days of holidays Enhanced parental leave. Hardware of your choice. Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more). Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.
