title: Senior Quantum Applications Architect
description: <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our architecture&nbsp;and approach&nbsp;is&nbsp;based on silicon photonics. By&nbsp;leveraging&nbsp;the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons&nbsp;don't&nbsp;feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025,&nbsp;PsiQuantum&nbsp;closed a&nbsp;$1 billion&nbsp;funding round that valued the company at&nbsp;$7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative,&nbsp;PsiQuantum's&nbsp;most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive&nbsp;Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas&nbsp;Zennström.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum&nbsp;also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including&nbsp;Airbus,&nbsp;Lockheed&nbsp;Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It&nbsp;represents&nbsp;a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be&nbsp;solved&nbsp;any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have&nbsp;the funding,&nbsp;the government&nbsp;validation, and&nbsp;the sites&nbsp;under construction to make it real.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Job Summary:</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1">Within the Quantum Algorithms team, we develop and adapt quantum algorithms, identify and scope promising use cases, and analyze their resource requirements. In this role, you will translate computational tasks into abstract quantum-algorithm specifications, analyze their asymptotic performance, and define meaningful problem instances that lie beyond the practical reach of classical computation. You will also work closely with PsiQuantum’s Compilation team to develop explicit implementations of these algorithms and evaluate their resource requirements on our architecture.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="582">In this position, you will be expected not only to conduct outstanding individual research, but also to formulate and lead broader research programs that draw on the work of other researchers and collaborators. You will contribute to cross-team initiatives spanning PsiQuantum’s applications, architecture, and compilation efforts, helping to connect algorithm design with the practical requirements of fault-tolerant quantum computation.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1023">The role will also involve external collaboration. You will have the opportunity to lead projects with industrial and research partners, working with domain experts to identify important computational challenges, formulate them as well-defined problems, and map them to appropriate quantum algorithms. Success in this work requires the ability to communicate across disciplinary boundaries and to move fluently between real-world applications, mathematical abstractions, algorithmic complexity, and implementation-level resource analysis.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1564">The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with scientific leadership, intellectual independence, and a collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable shaping open-ended research directions, assessing the practical significance of algorithmic advances, and guiding projects from the initial identification of an application through to a concrete fault-tolerant quantum algorithm and a detailed resource estimate.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Propose initiatives into research and development of quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers; act as primary contributor to research programs beyond the current state of the art in quantum algorithms design.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Work closely with external partners to instantiate, validate and optimize quantum algorithms for use cases across a variety of domains, such as life sciences, industry and sustainability.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Establish families of benchmarks and problem instances to validate post-classicality of quantum algorithms.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Guide both the simulation and analysis of resource requirements for fault tolerant implementation of quantum algorithms in photonic quantum computing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience/Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">5+ years of research experience (academia or industry) in the field of quantum computing, with focus on algorithms and applications. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">A degree in Physics, Math or Computer Science or equivalent is required. PhD in Physics, Math or Computer Science, with a focus on quantum information theory or quantum computation will be preferred. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Experience with quantum algorithms and compiling in the regime of fault tolerant gates preferred.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Experience working with partners in academia or industry to analyze real-world quantum applications of interest preferred.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Proven team player with an ability to work effectively across departments, sites and time zones.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Ability to work independently and contribute to fast-moving start-up environment.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Experience programming in Python, C++ or similar languages.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>PsiQuantum provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. PsiQuantum does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable laws.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Note: PsiQuantum will only reach out to you using an official PsiQuantum email address and will never ask you for bank account information as part of the interview process. Please report any suspicious activity to </strong><strong data-stringify-type="bold"><a class="c-link" ----- target="_blank" ----- ----- data-stringify-type="bold">.</strong></p> <p>We are not accepting unsolicited resumes from employment agencies.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The ranges below reflect the target ranges for a new hire base salary.&nbsp;Actual compensation may vary outside of these ranges and is dependent on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's qualifications including relevant education and training, competencies, experience, geographic location, and business needs. Base pay is only one part of the total compensation package. Full time roles are eligible for equity and benefits. Base pay is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p></div><div class="title">Daresbury, United Kingdom </div><div class="pay-range"><span>£78,900</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£92,900 GBP</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: UK Summer Internship 2027 - Public Sector Consulting
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="color: #00358e; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Baringa is looking for talented 2027 Summer Interns to join our Government &amp; Public Sector team!</span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Internship</span></span></h3> <p>Our internship programmes will give you a first-hand view of life in an award-winning management consultancy firm. You will gain an understanding of the consulting business model as well as hands-on experience across the consulting project lifecycle, from understanding client challenges and analysing evidence through to developing recommendations and supporting delivery</p> <p>As an intern you will join a real team, working and learning from experienced consultants, with exposure to meaningful client work alongside a structured programme to learn more about Baringa and working as a consultant.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">About the Government team at Baringa</span></h3> <p>Our Government team helps departments, agencies and public services solve complex problems and deliver better outcomes for citizens. Our work spans Central Government, Home Affairs, and Health and Public Infrastructure, from redesigning services and strengthening operations to using data, technology and AI to improve decisions and delivery.</p> <p>We work on Government’s most complex changes, partnering with departments across Whitehall and the wider public sector, using our skills in Strategy and Business Cases, Project Delivery, Operational Delivery, DDaT and Government Commercial.</p> <p>The UK public sector is navigating significant challenges and opportunities, including the delivery of major national priorities and missions. As our Public Sector team continues to grow, we are looking for curious and motivated interns who are excited to learn, contribute and develop with us. You do not need previous consulting or public sector experience – we are interested in how you approach problems, learn new things and apply your skills to real-world challenges.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">What you will be doing</span></h3> <p>We will embed you in a project for your internship period, working alongside a team of experienced consultants to learn whilst delivering real client outcomes. You will not be expected to know how to do all of this from day one. You will be supported throughout and given opportunities to build your skills through meaningful project work.</p> <p>Depending on the project you join, you may have the opportunity to:</p> <ul> <li>Analyse quantitative and qualitative information to identify insights, trends and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Explore how data, digital technology, automation or AI could help improve public services.</li> <li>Develop recommendations and delivery plans, considering how people, technology and data work together.</li> <li>Support the development of client materials, including presentations, reports, workshop outputs and project updates.</li> <li>Contribute to meetings and workshop discussions, helping to capture key points, actions and decisions.</li> <li>Learn how consulting teams work together to solve problems, structure ambiguous challenges and communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.</li> </ul> <p>Examples of the type of projects you could be working on are:</p> <ul> <li>Support transformation projects that help government and public sector organisations improve services, strengthen operations and deliver better outcomes for citizens.</li> <li>Help review how services and processes work, from frontline delivery through to internal operations, identifying opportunities to make them simpler, more effective or more resilient.</li> <li>Contribute to digital, data and analytics work, including projects that use AI or data-led approaches to help clients make better decisions.</li> <li>Support the development of business cases and funding proposals, helping clients assess different options and make evidence-based decisions.</li> <li>Help design how services should operate, looking at how people, processes, technology and data come together to deliver better results within operating models and service blueprints.</li> <li>Support commercial and procurement activity, such as researching suppliers, comparing options and helping prepare materials for decision-making.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">What are we looking for?</span></h3> <p>We welcome applications from students across a broad range of academic disciplines, including STEM and non-STEM subjects, and are particularly keen to hear from students who enjoy solving complex problems using evidence, data, technology and creative thinking. You do not need to have previous experience in consulting or the public sector - what matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in helping public sector organisations solve complex challenges.</p> <p>We are looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to learn how consulting teams work, contribute to meaningful client projects and develop their skills in a supportive environment. You may be a good fit if you bring:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Structured problem solving</strong>, with the ability to break down unfamiliar questions and identify what matters.</li> <li><strong>Data analysis skills</strong>, and comfort working with data to surface insight and support evidence-based recommendations.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Digital and AI literacy</strong>, with genuine curiosity about AI and its practical application, and a foundational understanding of how to use these tools responsibly and ethically.</li> <li><strong>Interest in policy, government and public service</strong>, and how national priorities translate into delivery on the ground.</li> <li><strong>Commercial and financial curiosity</strong>, with an interest in how money, value and delivery decisions shape public services, and comfort working with numbers to support them.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication skills</strong>, including the ability to explain ideas simply and structure your thinking in writing and conversation.</li> <li><strong>A collaborative approach</strong>, with enthusiasm for working in teams and learning from others.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to learn and adapt</strong>, particularly in a fast-paced project environment where priorities can evolve.</li> <li><strong>Attention to detail and ownership</strong>, taking pride in the quality of your work and following through on tasks.</li> <li><strong>A proactive attitude</strong>, with the confidence to ask questions, contribute ideas and get involved.</li> </ul> <p>We do not expect you to have all the answers from day one. We are looking for potential, enthusiasm and a genuine interest in developing your consulting skills while contributing to work that matters.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">What's in it for you?</span></h3> <p>An internship at Baringa is what you make it.</p> <p>This is an 8-week paid internship where you get real project experience alongside structured coaching and training with an opportunity to build your analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.</p> <p>You will leave the internship with practical consulting experience, a stronger understanding of public sector work, and a clearer view of whether consulting is the right career path for you. High performing interns may also be considered for a permanent role.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Requirements</span></h3> <p>Applicants should be in their penultimate year of their bachelor’s or master’s Degree studies. Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future and be eligible for a UK Security Check (SC) clearance. All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.</p> <p>Please note we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Key dates</span></h3> <p>Application window closes: Monday 28<sup>th</sup> September 2026 at&nbsp;<u>12:00pm GMT</u><br>Assessment centres: w/c 30<sup>th</sup> November / 7<sup>th</sup> December<br>Internship start: Monday 5<sup>th</sup> July 2027<br>Internship end: Friday 27<sup>th</sup> August 2027</p> <p><em>This is a paid full-time internship.</em></p> <p>For further information, please read our <a href="https://www.baringa.com/globalassets/careers/graduate/pdfs-and-downloads/global-summer-internship-pack-2026.pdf">Summer Internship 2027 pack</a></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h2><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span>&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);" data-contrast="none">Diversity and Inclusion</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.</span>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);" data-contrast="none">An award-winning workplace</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. </span><a href="https://www.baringa.com/en/impact/awards/"><span data-contrast="none">Click here</span></a><span data-contrast="none"> to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.</span>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Using business as a force for good.</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-teams="true">Join us</span></h3> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-teams="true">All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Clients and Marketing team are looking for an experienced Marketing Business Partner to join them.</span></span></h2> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Over the past nine months, Clients &amp; Marketing has evolved from a purist marketing function into a broadened, end-to-end Clients &amp; Marketing team. Our focus now spans from brand and market positioning through to deeper client relationships, improved win rates, revenue growth, and increased net margin. This is being underpinned by an operational transformation including&nbsp;cNPS, new ways of working, and a content management platform driving greater efficiency and effectiveness.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re&nbsp;now looking for the marketing and business development professionals that can guide us through this exciting transformation.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Partnering with the Clients &amp; Marketing Exec Sponsor and sector leadership teams to shape and deliver strategic marketing plans that advance sector priorities and drive measurable commercial impact.&nbsp;</li> <li>Leading the end‑to‑end delivery of campaign and event programmes, ensuring high‑quality execution and measurable commercial impact.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Building a strong understanding of client challenges, market trends, competitor activity, and Baringa’s sector capabilities to refine messaging, targeting, and segmentation.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Managing the in‑sector marketing team (where applicable), providing coaching, development, and day‑to‑day support.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Championing consistency, collaboration, and efficiency across sectors by working closely with fellow BPs and the wider Clients &amp; Marketing team.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Leading the creation of compelling messaging and visuals that clearly differentiate Baringa in the market. Leveraging thought leadership, client success stories, and insight‑driven narratives to deliver standout campaigns and assets.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Owning the sector marketing budget, ensuring responsible management, cost control, and ongoing value‑for‑money improvements.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Bringing the sector strategy to life across the business—building alignment, energy, and advocacy for campaign activity.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <ul> <li>Proven&nbsp;track record&nbsp;in shaping marketing strategy and the&nbsp;appropriate selection&nbsp;of tactics to drive a business forward and increase customer engagement and sales; use of the full multichannel mix.&nbsp; Strategic marketing experience in a B2B environment.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in professional services marketing, with a focus on Public Sector/Government clients.</li> <li>Expert relationship building and network creation – internally and with external parties.&nbsp;&nbsp;Ability to work across all levels with impact,&nbsp;effectiveness&nbsp;and influence.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>A background in Business Development, Account Growth and relationship management will be advantageous&nbsp;</li> <li>Proactive in pre-empting,&nbsp;identifying,&nbsp;resolving&nbsp;and escalating issues.&nbsp;&nbsp;Self-sufficient, self-starter.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Ideally educated to Degree level or equivalent. Ideally CIM Diploma-qualified or equivalent.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. Some of these benefits include:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></h3> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Generous Annual Leave Policy:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a <strong>Director, Slate Operations</strong> to join our Slate Development Group team in the UK remotely or in Barcelona, on a flexible hybrid model.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.&nbsp;</p> <p>Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework.</li> <li>Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change.</li> <li>Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it.</li> <li>Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing.</li> <li>Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is.&nbsp;</li> <li>Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide.</li> <li>Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean.</li> <li>Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF.</li> <li>Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation.</li> <li>Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience.</li> <li>10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team.</li> <li>You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against.</li> <li>You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread.</li> <li>You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&amp;D and live.</li> <li>You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. You make sound calls in the company's interest and know when to escalate.</li> <li>You can hold your own with P&amp;Ls and free-to-play KPIs.</li> <li>You spot the process that's slowing people down and fix it — and you'll push back and start the right debate when it matters.</li> <li>You build trust with all kinds of people at every level and don't flinch at the hard conversations — with the presence to grow into a partner to senior game leaders over time.</li> <li>You write clearly and fast, and you can build a strong deck with cross-functional input.</li> <li>Detail and organization come naturally to you.</li> <li>Low ego, business outcomes first, open to feedback — and genuinely curious about every part of the business.</li> <li>You play games and care about the industry.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate AI and Secure Technologies Engineer (2026 start)
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Cambridge, UK</strong><br><strong>UK travel and occasional international travel</strong></p> <h3><strong>Introduction</strong></h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re looking for graduates who are excited by the opportunity to make emerging technologies secure, trustworthy and resilient. You’ll work on real-world engineering challenges across cyber security, artificial intelligence, embedded systems and connected technologies, supporting projects in areas including defence and security, industrial systems and critical national infrastructure.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll need to be curious, willing to learn and comfortable exploring unfamiliar technical problems. title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What you'll do This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands. At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area. In this role, you will: Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results. Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land. Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments. Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current. Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own. Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases. Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched. Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure. Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams. Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice. Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them. Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends. What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs. 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions. Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught. Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one. Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops. Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak. Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in. Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path. Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear. Clear written communication. Mapbox is distributed across time zones and we make most decisions in documents and Slack. Nice to have traits for this role Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources. Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to. Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports. Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built. Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience. Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word. Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity. Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do. What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How we support you Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents. Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies. Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. Execution</strong> (Determined &amp; Relentless Mindset)</p> <ul> <li>Own the strategic roadmap, budget, and resource planning for the Fan Services customer service organization, aligning headcount, technology, and vendor/BPO investment to business goals.</li> <li>Drive performance management across the team with a disciplined focus on financial targets and third-party SLAs, ensuring accountability at every level of the organization.</li> <li>Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating the ability to manage competing priorities with urgency and composure while delivering results at scale.</li> <li>Communicate clearly and confidently in writing, speaking, and digital formats to senior-level and C-level audiences, translating operational complexity into strategic insight.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>AI &amp; DIGITAL CAPABILITY</strong></p> <p>We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:</p> <ul> <li>Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes</li> <li>Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance</li> <li>Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working</li> <li>Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>CAPABILITIES &amp; EXPERIENCE YOU BRING</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of customer operations experience, including deep expertise in first and second line contact management and managing own and 3PL operations.</li> <li>7+ years of people leadership experience, including demonstrated success leading leaders and managers across on-premises, hybrid, and remote environments.</li> <li>Experience and understanding of omni-channel operations and the e-commerce space.</li> <li>Advanced communication skills in writing, speaking, and digital formats, with the ability to deliver comfortably to senior-level and C-level audiences.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, including foundational experience with Excel and pivot tables; knowledgeable user of CRM technologies, Conversation-Analytics Software, Contact Center Technologies, Customer Review Tools, and order management tools such as EDI, DAX, and Cloud Reporting.</li> <li>Proven track record of owning departmental budgets, headcount planning, and BPO/vendor relationships including performance, cost, and contract oversight.</li> <li>Multi-lingual candidates are encouraged to apply; Spanish, French, and German are preferred.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Education:</strong></p> <p>Bachelor's degree in business, communications, management, or a related field.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WORK LOCATION</strong></p> <p>On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Stakehill.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</em><br><br><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.</em></p> <p><strong><em>ABOUT THE TEAM</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, <a href="http://www.fanatics.com">www.fanatics.com</a>.</em><br><br><em>Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).</em><br><br><em>At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:</em><br><em>· Build Championship Teams</em><br><em>· Obsessed with Fans</em><br><em>· Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit</em><br><em>· Determined and Relentless Mindset</em></p> <p><em>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our&nbsp;<a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator (RevTech)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.</p> <p>Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to <strong>be curious, have courage, and commit fully</strong>.</p> <p>Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator (RevTech) to join our Information Systems team, responsible for the technical ownership, administration, and optimisation of our Salesforce based Revenue Technology stack.</p> <p>This role will play a critical part in ensuring our commercial systems (Sales Cloud, Gong, QuotaPath, ABM platforms, and other related tools) are reliable, well-integrated, and enabling scalable revenue operations.</p> <p>You will work within our Salesforce team, liaising closely with the data team, and business stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to ensure systems and integrations support end-to-end revenue processes and help optimise the tech stack to deliver tech efficiencies to the company.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>RevTech System Ownership</li> <ul> <li>Act as the technical SME for the RevTech ecosystem, ensuring systems are scalable, secure, and aligned to business needs.</li> <li>Own the administration, configuration, and ongoing optimisation of RevTech tools (Salesforce Sales Cloud, Gong, QuotaPath, ABM platforms, enablement tools).</li> </ul> <li>Integration &amp; Data</li> <ul> <li>Monitor and support integrations between Salesforce, RevTech tools and other key business systems.</li> <li>Investigate data-flow issues and work with internal engineering teams or external partners to resolve them.</li> <li>Gather requirements and contribute Salesforce expertise to integration design.</li> <li>Support the move towards an enterprise integration model using MuleSoft.</li> </ul> <li>Process Enablement</li> <ul> <li>Support key revenue processes such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, and customer lifecycle management.Partner with RevOps, Sales, Finance and CS teams to translate business requirements into system solutions.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.</li> </ul> <li>Data &amp; Reporting</li> <ul> <li>Ensure accurate and timely data flows between systems to support reporting and analytics.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Data team to ensure RevTech data is properly modelled and available in downstream systems (e.g. Databricks, BI tools).</li> </ul> <li>Governance &amp; Best Practice</li> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain standards for system configuration, documentation, and change management.</li> <li>Ensure appropriate access controls, compliance, and auditability across the RevTech stack.</li> <li>Contribute to overall enterprise architecture and systems strategy.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Criteria&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong hands-on Salesforce administration experience using Sales Cloud.</li> <li>Experience configuring Salesforce Flow, validation rules, permission sets, integrations, reports and dashboards.</li> <li>Experience supporting RevOps systems such as Gong, QuotaPath, Outreach, Salesloft or similar platforms.</li> <li>A good understanding of SaaS integrations and how data moves between Salesforce and connected systems.</li> <li>Experience supporting revenue processes such as lead-to-opportunity, customer lifecycle management or quote-to-cash.</li> <li>Ability to translate requirements from Sales, Customer Success and Finance into practical system improvements.</li> <li>Strong troubleshooting, documentation and stakeholder-management skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Criteria</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Einstein Conversation Insights, Gong or similar conversation intelligence tools&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working in an M&amp;A, PE backed, high-growth SaaS environment.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Mulesoft.</li> <li>Familiarity with data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake) and data pipelines.</li> <li>Exposure to quote-to-cash processes and RevOps tooling.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Join our team and enjoy a competitive salary with bonus opportunities, flexible work schedules, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits. We offer flexible time off plans, career growth through development programs, and a collaborative, innovative culture where your ideas matter.&nbsp; Ready to make an impact? Apply today and be part of a company that invests in your success!</p> <p>We are committed to providing a Drug-Free Workplace for all employees.</p> <p>We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>You can view our Recruitment and Selection Policy <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yDxHyVbhh8MK9NnCYdnEAfVSO4rhPCovVbKK8ecxT4U/edit?usp=sharing">here.</a></p> <p>Please click the link for our <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1uAKvHVSRsqZ83CGhM3_3Dc6RPsXwlTdmwdUH7msHkVM/edit?usp=sharing">Privacy Notice</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Payments Optimisation Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This role is responsible for making sure customers can pay successfully and that the business is not losing revenue through avoidable payment failures. This role will identify issues, bring the right teams together and ensure that changes are implemented and measured.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Role purpose</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Will be responsible for ensuring that all payment methods, payment providers and checkout journeys operate to an optimal standard across the business.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will monitor payment acceptance, identify performance issues and opportunities, and work with payment service providers, acquiring banks, technology teams, product teams and commercial stakeholders to improve successful payment completion and reduce avoidable customer friction.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The successful candidate will take ownership of payment-performance reporting, incident escalation and optimisation activity, ensuring that issues are identified quickly, investigated thoroughly and converted into measurable improvements in revenue and customer experience.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Payment performance monitoring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor payment performance across cards, digital wallets, PayPal, BNPL and other alternative payment methods.&nbsp;</li> <li>Track authorisation, acceptance and completion rates by brand, market, payment method, provider, issuer, device and customer journey.&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify deterioration, unusual trends and performance gaps requiring investigation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop appropriate alerts and thresholds so material payment issues are identified quickly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain regular reporting that clearly explains performance, causes of movement and actions being taken.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance investigation and optimisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Investigate payment failures and determine whether the cause sits with the PSP, acquirer, issuer, internal technology, checkout journey, fraud controls or customer behaviour.&nbsp;</li> <li>Analyse decline codes, authentication outcomes, technical failures, retries and abandonment points.&nbsp;</li> <li>Recommend changes to improve acceptance while maintaining appropriate fraud and risk controls.&nbsp;</li> <li>Measure the impact of changes and demonstrate the resulting revenue, acceptance or customer-experience benefit.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain a prioritised payment-optimisation roadmap.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PSP and partner management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the operational performance contact for PSPs, acquirers and payment-method partners.&nbsp;</li> <li>Challenge providers where performance falls below expectations and ensure issues are investigated and resolved.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hold regular performance reviews with partners and track agreed actions through to completion.&nbsp;</li> <li>Compare provider performance across markets, payment methods and transaction types.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support commercial discussions by providing performance evidence and identifying service or contractual shortcomings.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Internal stakeholder management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Technology, Product, Finance, Fraud, Treasury, Customer Experience and Commercial teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>Translate complex payment issues into clear business language and explain the revenue and customer impact.&nbsp;</li> <li>Coordinate internal investigations and ensure actions have clear owners and deadlines.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support new payment-method launches, PSP migrations and checkout changes from a performance perspective.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure payment-performance requirements are considered during product and technical design.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting and governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Produce weekly and monthly payment-performance reporting for senior stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide clear commentary on what changed, why it changed and what action is required.&nbsp;</li> <li>Track incidents, root causes, corrective actions and realised benefits.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain appropriate documentation for payment journeys, providers, escalation routes and performance expectations.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key measures of success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Overall payment acceptance and completion rate.&nbsp;</li> <li>Card authorisation rate.&nbsp;</li> <li>Payment-method performance by provider, brand and market.&nbsp;</li> <li>Reduction in avoidable technical and processing failures.&nbsp;</li> <li>Revenue recovered or protected through optimisation activity.&nbsp;</li> <li>Speed of identification and resolution of payment incidents.&nbsp;</li> <li>Delivery of PSP and internal corrective actions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Performance of retries and recovery journeys.&nbsp;</li> <li>Customer payment abandonment and failure rates.&nbsp;</li> <li>Accuracy and usefulness of payment-performance reporting.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working in payments, ecommerce, financial services or a related environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of online payment journeys and payment service providers.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience analysing payment acceptance, authorisation or transaction-performance data.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes and commercial opportunities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working with PSPs, acquirers or other external payment partners.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to coordinate technical and non-technical stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex issues clearly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Commercial awareness and an understanding of how payment performance affects revenue and customer experience.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple investigations and actions.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of card schemes, issuers, acquirers and payment-processing flows.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of 3DS, SCA, exemptions, tokenisation, network tokens and account updater services.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with digital wallets, PayPal, BNPL and alternative payment methods.&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of payment decline codes and issuer behaviour.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience using SQL, BI tools or payment analytics platforms.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of fraud controls and the relationship between acceptance and fraud risk.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience supporting PSP migrations, payment orchestration or new payment-method launches.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in a high-volume international ecommerce environment.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Personal attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Data-led and commercially focused.&nbsp;</li> <li>Proactive and comfortable challenging internal teams and external providers.&nbsp;</li> <li>Naturally curious and willing to investigate issues in detail.&nbsp;</li> <li>Able to remain calm and structured during payment incidents.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong ownership mentality with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes.&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfortable operating across technical, operational and commercial teams.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse &amp; inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. title: Senior CRM Manager
description: We’re on a mission to make migration easy. We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. CRM sits within the User Experience team, helping Marshmallow build more effective, joined-up communication with our customers across the business. CRM is a meaningful driver of impact for the organisation, with clear opportunities to improve how we engage customers and measure the value of that work. This role will help shape how CRM is used at Marshmallow by building strong foundations, enabling others to use the platform effectively, and creating the governance needed to make customer communications work better across multiple teams. We’re looking for someone who is excited by ownership, enjoys working cross-functionally, and wants to help scale CRM in a thoughtful, high-impact way. This is an individual contributor role with deep platform and governance ownership, rather than a people-management track. Your impact and progression come from the scale and quality of the systems, frameworks, and cross-team relationships you build, not from growing a team. London (hybrid, 3 days in office) Please note we are not in a position to offer sponsorship and/or a visa for this position. What you'll be doing Own and evolve Marshmallow’s CRM operations capability, helping shape how the platform is used across the organisation. Build strong governance frameworks for CRM activity, including how campaigns are prioritised, sequenced, and managed across teams Enable and support stakeholders across the business to use CRM effectively, increasing adoption while maintaining quality and consistency. Partner cross-functionally with teams across the organisation to identify opportunities, align on priorities, and improve customer communications. Use data and testing insights to inform decisions, optimise performance, and ensure CRM activity is driving measurable impact Drive high-quality campaign execution through strong operational processes, audience segmentation, scheduling, and platform management. Who you are You’re a self-starter who is comfortable with a high level of autonomy and enjoys taking ownership of ambiguous, high-impact work. You’re curious and collaborative , and you like working with lots of different stakeholders to move work forward. You’re someone who believes in enabling others , not gatekeeping expertise, and you’re motivated by helping teams do better work together You’re commercially minded and pragmatic , with a strong instinct for where to focus your time to unlock the most value What you'll bring Experience working in CRM operations or CRM management within an in-house, tech-led business , with a strong understanding of growth-focused customer communications. Recent hands-on experience with Braze is preferable for the role, alongside practical experience building and managing CRM campaigns, segmentation, metadata, scheduling, and audience setup Proven experience creating CRM governance and enabling other teams to use CRM effectively across an organisation Strong data literacy , including analysing campaign or email test performance, pulling audiences and segments, and working independently with data rather than relying entirely on analyst support. Confidence in using data tools or AI-assisted analysis to generate insights and support decision-making. Perks of the job Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year Our Process We break it up into a few stages: Initial call with our Talent Acquisition Manager (approx. 40 mins via Zoom) A past experience interview with our Hiring Manager (60 minutes via Zoom) An Onsite task, where we would like to see how you think on your feet (120 minutes in-person) Culture interview with one of our senior Marshmallow leads (60 minutes via Zoom) Background checks As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment, we’ll carry out standard background checks, including a DBS and a Cifas check . These help ensure there are no ongoing criminal proceedings and support the prevention of fraud and other forms of serious misconduct. If anything of concern is identified, it may affect your eligibility for certain roles or services. Feel free to ask our Talent Acquisition team if you have any questions about this! #LI-OB1 Diversity of thought We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Partner, Strategic Account Management
description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. About the Role The AI Startups and scaleups we work with have roles they can't fill. Not because they haven't tried, but because they have world-class hiring bars, and it’s genuinely tough. As a Talent Partner looking after our clients, you own those relationships. You take a role briefing properly, you push back when it doesn't add up, and you become the person a founder, internal talent partner or hiring manager calls before they've even decided to hire. You will also own delivery: ensuring that our clients receive an amazing experience using Dex. You'll also be a power user of our product. We use Dex on our own hiring every day, and the feedback loop between you and the people building it should be strong. In this role you will: Own a portfolio of client relationships end to end; brief, delivery, feedback, and everything after Take role briefs / kick-offs that actually hold up. Scope the role, interrogate the requirements, and tell a client when the role is really two roles, or shouldn't be hired at all Run the process on the client side: keep feedback fast, keep interviews moving, keep momentum from breaking Analyse their Dex pipelines with conviction and manage expectations so offers land Negotiate offers with the client. Get people over the line without either side feeling managed Grow accounts. Turn a single search into a relationship; more roles, more trust, more of the hiring plan Be the client's most useful call of the week; delivering market insights, clear pipeline reporting, honest candidate reads, and effective advice About you You are highly organised, compelling, smart, and driven. You're commercially sharp and comfortable holding your ground with senior people. You'd rather have the awkward conversation early than the expensive one late. You tell great stories, and you know how to engage with a wide variety of different people - such as a first-time founder, a Head of Engineering, or a VP of Talent. You're credible with technical hiring managers and you understand how to be an effective partner to your stakeholders. You know enough about software engineering to be taken seriously, and you're honest about what you don't know. You have an excellent command of talent metrics. You know what good looks like at each stage of a funnel, and you use those numbers to diagnose and address a stalling process. You can walk a client through their own data, show them where they're losing people and why. We're open on backgrounds. Most people who do this well have 2+ years in recruitment (agency or internal) but if you've got the raw ingredients and the drive we want to talk to you. We want people who have excelled in their current and previous roles. We are looking for someone that is incredibly motivated to build an exceptional team, solving a problem that truly matters. Note: We know that talent can't be summed up in a few bullet points. Even if you don't match everything we've mentioned, we don't want that to be a barrier. If you're excited about what we're building, we want to hear from you. Why this is a great opportunity Dex represents an opportunity to join a well funded, cash generative business that works with some of the most interesting people and companies in the world. You'll be building relationships with some of the best AI startups and scaleups on the planet, and helping them hire the roles they care most about. We're growing fast and are set to more than double in headcount between the UK and US over the next 12 months. This is a team that deeply understands hiring, how difficult and how important it is; you'll have experienced talent leaders around you day to day, and a product team building tools for you specifically. What we offer Above market base salary plus uncapped commission; we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition Significant equity - we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take Full private healthcare & dental - because life happens and we want to support you Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support Gym membership & wellness benefits Claude tokens - lots and lots of Claude tokens Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip MacBook Pro + team kit "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support The process Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and respectful of your time.
