title: Account Management Lead – Editions France
description: Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you. Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network. The Role As Account Management Lead – Editions France , you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market. You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone. You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing. What You’ll Be Doing Editions Strategy & Growth Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion) Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites Occupancy & Commercial Performance Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale P&L Ownership & Governance Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale Senior Stakeholder Management Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network What You’ll Need to Thrive 7+ years working in commercially focused roles Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time Mix of both strategy and execution experience Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs) Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable Fluent in French and English is required Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you! Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Supply Chain Data & Operations Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Supply Planning à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027.

Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). 

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Supply Planning, vos principales missions seront :

1. Opérationnel & optimisation

  • Piloter les flux de rebalancing de stock entre nos entrepôts en interface directe avec nos partenaires logistiques internationaux 
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité de nos données opérationnelles en proposant une meilleure lecture / compréhension de la performance : un levier clé pour affiner nos prévisions de ventes et de commandes 
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de l'équipe Supply Planning
  • Contribuer aux analyses ad-hoc de l’équipe (non exhaustif : étude positionnement prix, taux de retour, évolution des écoulements, impact mix géographique etc.). 

2. Projet fil rouge : dashboard de performance opérationnelle / performance planning

Tout au long du stage, vous piloterez la création d'un outil centralisé de suivi de notre performance opérationnelle / performance planning :

  • Cadrer et concevoir : définir les KPI clés liés aux besoins métier et choisir la solution technique adaptée.
  • Structurer la donnée : identifier les sources et automatiser les flux de données pour garantir la fiabilité et la robustesse de l’outil.
  • Tester et déployer : votre objectif principal sera d’assurer l’adoption de votre outil aux processus métier.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou d'université avec une spécialisation en Supply Chain, et recherchez un stage de césure ou de fin d’études de 6 mois
  • Vous êtes une personne rigoureuse, organisée et curieuse
  • Vous maîtrisez impérativement Excel
  • Vous êtes proactif(ve) et possédez un bon esprit analytique 
  • Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe, l’envie de partager et développer vos compétences dans un environnement agile et dynamique

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.
